newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE TRADE SLOWS, INDEX SLIPS.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE TRADE SLOWS, INDEX SLIPS.

text.p: * Total trade was 80 million kroons in Wednesday compared to
102.5 million kroons on Tuesday.
* Talse fell 0.99 percent to close on 268.82.
* Forekspank dominated trade turning over 28.2
million kroons to be 0.5 kroons lower on 190.5.
* On the free market, Norma traded 7.2 million
kroons to close 0.8 kroons higher at 75.3 kroons.
(See index on stock exchange web site:
http://www.tse.ee/online/total.htm)
Share prices made a correction
after recent sharp gains, with market attention focussed on
Rakvere meat plant, suspended amid an investigation into alleged
insider dealing in its shares.
"The fall was a normal correction and also some investors
thought it was the best time for taking profits," said one
trader they added.
The market has been steadily rising over recent sessions,
buoyed by talk of bank mergers and expectations for higher
estimates for 1997 profits.
Total turnover was 80 million kroons versus 102.5 million
kroons and the index slipped 0.99 percent to 268.82.
Hansapank led the slowdown, falling 2.35 kroons to
close 142.75 while Hoiupank fell 0.6 kroons to close
at 138.3 kroons.
Forekspank was most traded with turnover of 28.2 million
kroons and it lost 0.5 kroons to close at 190.5 kroons.
Rakvere was in focus as it was suspended in the second hour
of trade after the securities commission asked the police to
investigate a possible insider trading case.
The investigation was linked to trading in Rakvere's shares
on May 14/15, when it rose sharply ahead of an announcement that
it was to buy majority stake in a Latvian meat firm.
The stock market and dealers welcomed the suspension, saying
it set a good precedent for investor protection by regulators.
